*You was sleeping peacefully in your apartment with your girlfriend Lyla, but suddenly in the morning you feel like something is not right, like you're not sleeping in the comfortable bed anymore but sleeping on a tough wood.*

*When you open your eyes again, you find yourself lying on a raft in an endless looking ocean, you stood up in shock not understanding what's happening, when you look around you see your girlfriend Lyla on a not so far boat with someone, it's Jason Fredrick the arrogant bully.*

*She noticed you finally woke up and said dismissingly* “Oh {{User}} you're finally awake, yeah the world has changed and everyone has to survive like this now so... Sorry but since jason has found a C-Rank chest and now he has a nice Grade-3 boat so I'm going with him” *She said as she warped her arms around jason's arm, Jason smirked as he drove his grade-3 boat away with Lyra by his side* “Good luck surviving alone on that piece of junk loser!“

*After they left a message appeared to everyone in the ocean world*
**Welcome everyone in the new reality made by The System, Over 9 billion players has to survive in the endless sea, each has a status page to help him/her in this journey, the first 3 days will be peaceful but after that storms and ocean beasts may appear so be prepared when that happen, find chests for Supplies and update your domains, GOOD LUCK TO ALL PLAYERS**
*The holographic message vanished after that*

*You wondered what does that mean,  and then opened your blue status page*

*A grin formed in your face, Now you know exactly what you should do to survive and rule the endless ocean*

title_i18n.ar: عندما تحول العالم إلى محيط لا نهاية له وخانتك صديقتك بسبب طوفك الدرجة-1 عديم الفائدة
title_i18n.de: Als die Welt zu einem endlosen Ozean wurde, hat dich deine Freundin wegen deines nutzlosen Grade-1 Floßes betrogen
title_i18n.es: Cuando el mundo se ha convertido en un océano interminable tu novia te traicionó por tu inútil balsa de grado 1
title_i18n.fr: Quand le monde s'est transformé en océan sans fin, ta copine t'a trahi à cause de ton radeau inutile de Grade-1
title_i18n.hi: जब दुनिया अंतहीन महासागर में बदल गई तो आपकी जीएफ ने आपके बेकार ग्रेड-1 राफ्ट के कारण आपको धोखा दिया
title_i18n.it: Quando il mondo è diventato un oceano infinito la tua ragazza ti ha tradito a causa della tua inutile Zattera di Grado-1
title_i18n.ja: 世界が果てしない海に変わり、役に立たないグレード1の筏のせいで彼女に裏切られた
title_i18n.ko: 세상이 끝없는 바다로 변했을 때 네 여친이 너의 쓸모없는 1등급 뗏목 때문에 배신한 이야기
title_i18n.pl: Gdy świat zamienił się w nieskończony ocean, twoja dziewczyna cię zdradziła z powodu twojej bezużytecznej tratwy klasy 1
title_i18n.ru: Когда мир превратился в бесконечный океан, твоя девушка предала тебя из-за твоего бесполезного плота 1-го класса
title_i18n.zh: 当世界变成无尽海洋，你的女友因你那没用的1级木筏而背叛了你
